
## 2026-03-12 - [O(1) String Highlighting in React]
**Learning:** [When using `String.prototype.split` with a capturing group regex to highlight text segments, the resulting array is strictly alternating: even indices are non-matches and odd indices are matches. This allows O(1) identification of matches (`index % 2 === 1`) instead of performing an O(N) lookup (`highlightWords.some(...)`) during rendering.]
**Action:** [Always utilize index modulo math (`index % 2 === 1`) for highlighting chunks inside React `.map()` loops when dealing with array parts generated by capturing-group split, avoiding unnecessary lookups and nested loops.]
